questions.prompt: In July 2026, Maharashtra, Gujarat, Rajasthan and Madhya Pradesh settled a decades-old dispute over dues relating to which dam?
questions.explain: The four states settled their long-running dispute over Sardar Sarovar dam dues on 8 July 2026. Union Home Minister Amit Shah credited the settlement to double-engine government.
questions.source: Maharashtra, Gujarat, Rajasthan, and Madhya Pradesh settled a decades-old dispute over Sardar Sarovar dam dues, which Amit Shah credited to double-engine government.
